oneLiner: 系统无序程度的度量，也是热力学第二定律的核心。
oneLinerEn: A measure of disorder and the heart of the second law.

oneLiner: 光的量子，静质量为零的电磁场能量包。
oneLinerEn: The quantum of light, a massless packet of EM energy.

oneLiner: 空间中每点赋予一个物理量的分布，如引力场、电磁场。
oneLinerEn: An assignment of a physical quantity to every point in space.

oneLiner: 电离气体，由自由电子与离子组成，物质的第四态。
oneLinerEn: Ionized gas of free electrons and ions — the fourth state of matter.

oneLiner: 波在一个周期内传播的距离，符号 λ。
oneLinerEn: Distance a wave travels in one period, symbol λ.

oneLiner: 单位时间内振动的次数，单位赫兹 Hz。
oneLinerEn: Oscillations per unit time, in hertz (Hz).

oneLiner: 既有大小又有方向的物理量，如位移、力、速度。
oneLinerEn: A quantity with magnitude and direction, e.g. displacement, force, velocity.

oneLiner: 不受外力、保持静止或匀速直线运动的参考系。
oneLinerEn: A frame at rest or in uniform motion, free of net force.

oneLiner: 物理量不可再分的最小单元；微观世界离散化的体现。
oneLinerEn: The smallest indivisible unit of a quantity; discreteness in the micro-world.

oneLiner: 微观粒子既表现波动性也表现粒子性。
oneLinerEn: Microscopic particles exhibit both wave and particle behavior.
